decisions.question: Treat Relaycast publication and recipient reachability as separate observations
decisions.chosen: Treat Relaycast publication and recipient reachability as separate observations
decisions.reasoning: An accepted durable message is not confirmed PTY delivery; the API must preserve publication success while reporting live, offline, or unknown without a delivered boolean.

decisions.question: Keep the reachability probe outside the publication timeout
decisions.chosen: Keep the reachability probe outside the publication timeout
decisions.reasoning: A slow best-effort read must not turn an already-accepted DM into an HTTP send failure; the probe has its own five-second bound and the RelayFlow makes it slower than the configured publish deadline.

decisions.question: Keep the synchronous reachability snapshot bounded at five seconds
decisions.chosen: Keep the synchronous reachability snapshot bounded at five seconds
decisions.reasoning: Issue 1615 explicitly requires the send response to carry the server-observed recipient state. Waiting for the independently bounded GET is the cost of that contract; it cannot alter publication success and remains below the outer 30-second API reply bound.

decisions.question: Applied independent review findings without weakening the effect oracle
decisions.chosen: Applied independent review findings without weakening the effect oracle
decisions.reasoning: Preserved required TypeScript targets via runtime normalization, exposed the response in Swift, classified all live Relaycast activity states, made the timeout control exceed the real 500ms clamp, and added unavailable/non-recipient controls.

decisions.question: Cancel reachability observation when publication fails
decisions.chosen: Cancel reachability observation when publication fails
decisions.reasoning: The observation is only part of a successful publication response. Awaiting it after an immediate publish failure delays the error and blocks the broker runtime actor for no usable evidence; the RelayFlow now measures this negative path.

decisions.question: Resolve Relaycast @self before reachability probing
decisions.reasoning: @self names the authenticated sender, not an agent record. Probing publish_from preserves the successful self-DM semantics and reports the actual recipient; the RelayFlow now proves one self-injection.

decisions.question: Treat legacy away as reachable
decisions.reasoning: Relaycast SDK compatibility still exposes pre-active-status away records; a best-effort reachability snapshot must not downgrade those live-compatible records to unknown.
